title: engram_test_child_temp accepts a child-temp link to another directory inside the Engram home
outcome: src/engram_test_child_temp.rs (on master since the earlier fixture-child redirect) accepts an existing `<home>/child-temp` only if its canonical path's parent is the canonical home. A child-temp junction or symlink pointing at ANOTHER directory directly inside the same home therefore passes, and the fixture child's TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR go into that directory. The same flaw in the new terminal helper (src/terminal_test_child_temp.rs) was raised as a Medium by train-32 fix reviewer Codex delegation-f5ddf880-9e3f-47b5-a21f-c3e959945ed6 and fixed there: the helper refuses a link (symlink_metadata is_symlink) and requires canonical == `<root>/child-temp`. This one is pre-existing: master reaches it today on the same path. The existing test a_child_temp_that_links_out_of_its_engram_home_is_refused links only to a target OUTSIDE the home. Fix by the same two checks, with a same-home sibling-link regression test. cfg(test) only; no production change.
acceptance: engram_test_child_temp accepts a child-temp link to another directory inside the Engram home is done
